title: Towards Hierarchical Rectified Flow
tldr_zh: 速度空间再做一层 RF（学加速度）建模多模态速度分布，采样路径可相交更直；CIFAR-10 5 NFE FID 30.9 vs RF 36.2，位置层仅 1–2 步
tldr_en: Hierarchical rectified flow learns the full multimodal velocity distribution via a second RF in velocity space; intersecting, straighter paths give lower FID at equal total NFE on MNIST/CIFAR-10.
key_numbers: MNIST FID at 50 NFE: RF 5.61 vs HRF2 2.66 with ~1.07M params each (Table 7)
ImageNet-32 FID at 5 NFE: RF 69.23 vs HRF2 48.93; at 20/50 NFE HRF2 slightly worse (Table 7)
HRF2 CIFAR-10 model 44.81M params vs RF 35.75M; inference ~33% slower at equal NFE (Tables 5-6)
Velocity distribution closed form pi_1(v;x_t,t) = rho_0(x_t - t v) rho_1(x_t + (1-t) v) / rho_t(x_t) (Thm 1)
